visual_review: Heavy squared maul head with rear wedge, riveted straps, banded wood haft and open butt ring. Solid concentric ripples remain entirely within the square striking face, dull oxide-red deepest ring contained with no external sound lines or glow. Dented brass cup-shaped bugle mouthpiece mounted at the collar; no musical notes or bell-shaped head. Shaft/socket coherent, family silhouette retained. Candidate only, no artistic approval.
